title: Hidden weapons bunker under a fake generator at Saddam's compound
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Hidden weapons bunker under a fake generator at Saddam's compound, about Gulf War era at Saddam Hussein's private facility, Iraq, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: found out that it was hollow and that it would tilt back. And when it tilted back, there were steps going down into a weapons bunker that you wouldn't believe.

plain: A former US Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells of a private facility belonging to Saddam Hussein, the former ruler of Iraq, around the time of the Gulf War. He says a generator there turned out to be hollow and would tilt back, and that underneath it steps led down into a weapons bunker "that you wouldn't believe." He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as something he says he took part in finding, and if it is true it shows how well such places could be hidden.
